task_title: Diagnose and fix floor1-2 chain/floor2 win-rate failures

plan_review.notes: Reviewer flagged: (1) whether the nightly-balance-issue automation counts as the release workflow vs deploy.yml itself -- resolved: nightly-balance-issue runs on a schedule and always resolves the newest published release baseline, so it effectively re-checks after every release without needing deploy.yml changes; (2) post-fix re-measurement should use canonical legs, not local smoke -- resolved: per explicit maintainer instruction, diagnosis and before/after evidence use the already-published real release baseline RunStats (baselines branch), not a freshly dispatched sweep; the next automatic release sweep is the canonical re-measurement and the new nightly ask self-corrects if it has not improved; (3) chain-failure diagnosis should use progression-runner leg/carryover data, not just flattened final RunStats -- adopted, background agent instructed to analyze legs["floor1-chain"].runs and legs.floor2.runs separately; (4) telemetry set should include progression/den/combat fields, not just movementQuality, for non-movement failure modes -- adopted, real baseline analysis showed movementQuality.stuckPct + aiTelemetry.decisionStateMs already sufficiently explains the dominant timeout bucket (stuck/wiggle during ENGAGE), with family/den completion spread thin across many families ruling out a single mapgen lockout; (5) spell out concrete ledger/verify steps -- adopted into this session checklist.

rounds.notes: Flagged non-null assertions in settlement-return cycle index handling; resolved by adding explicit cycle guard and structured status-index lookup.
Flagged positional magic constants for armed/cooldown indexes; resolved by deriving indexes by status label.
Flagged seed-rationale comments; resolved by documenting behavioral fixture selection rather than balance sampling.
Flagged exact frame numbers in comments; resolved by keeping only stable behavioral criteria.
Flagged assertion structure and silent return risk; resolved by removing the silent return and asserting named telemetry/status indexes.

Final clean re-review could not be obtained: the code_review tool timed out and instructed not to rerun. No known actionable code-review concern remains after the latest fix; escalated for human confirmation per the bounded-loop policy.

escalated_to_human.reason: Automated code_review did not produce a clean terminal round after repeated addressed low-level test-assertion findings, then timed out with an instruction not to rerun. Human confirmation is required for the final assertion shape.

findings.detail: For a declared 3🍎 change the ledger's code_review stage is incomplete. Complete the code-review loop before PR finalization.
The release-path nightly balance automation is cohesive around the win-rate theme and tested, but could have been a sibling automation change.
The deterministic AI behavior change required updating one settlement-return fixture seed; verify affected headless coverage remains green.

independent_grade.notes: The core fix is sound: it closes a real Floor 2 stall where updateEngageWatchdog's ignoredEnemyUntilFrame blacklist was ignored by findNearestFloor2HuntEnemy/findNearestFloor2Boss, letting the AI immediately re-select the same unreachable target and loop forever, plus an ENGAGE-abandon guard mirroring the existing COLLECT/EXPLORE pattern. The logic is deterministic, stays within src/game/ai layer boundaries, self-heals via time-bounded ignore with expiry cleanup, and is backed by a headless regression that asserts victory, kill count, stuckPct<25, and replay determinism. The automation half is unit-tested and documented. No blocker was found, so this passes while the ledger is completed before PR.
